Key Risks:
The risk of loss resulting from
inadequate or failed internal
processes, people and systems
or from external events.

The risk of accidental or
intentional illegal use, access,
modification, disclosure or
destruction of information
resources, which would
compromise the confidentiality,
integrity and availability of
information assets. Technology
risk on the other hand is the
risk of loss and disruption due
to exploitation of network
vulnerabilities, system failures
or defects or from illegal use of
bank systems.

Business continuity
management (BCM) is a
process that identifies potential
operational disruptions and
provides a basis for planning for
the mitigation of the negative
impact from such disruptions.

Financial crime includes money
laundering, fraud, bribery and
corruption and misconduct
by employees, customers,
suppliers, business partners and
stakeholders.
